newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares dull, eyes on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares dull, eyes on Monday.

text.p: The Estonian bourse was very quiet on Friday with many taking an extra holiday and low liquidity moving prices more than normally expected, dealers said.
The Talse gained by 0.09 percent to close on 261.63 kroons with 22.9 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
"It was mostly a quiet day because of the one day between two holidays," one trader said.
"It seemed that every single client order affected the market because of the low liquidity," he added.
"Monday could be a trend-setting day, many investors have had four days off and may have made a decision on where the market could go," another dealer said.
Uhispank was the most active stock with 7.8 million kroons of shares traded. The price fell to a low of 48.25 before regaining some ground to close 0.75 kroons lower at 50.75.
"Towards afternoon some larger long-term investors picked it up and took the price almost back to where it started from," one dealer said.
Hansapank turned over 4.8 million kroons of shares to be 0.12 kroons lower on 136.88 kroons.
The over-the-counter market trade was stronger with 9.5 million kroons of trade with diversified industrialist Norma the most active stock.
Norma ended lower on 75.15 kroons, down 0.35 kroons, after turning over 8.9 million kroons.
"There was nothing new to really move Norma -- it seems that it was one place for some investors test the market," another dealer said.
